author: International Energy Agency
title: Global hydrogen review 2026: Demand
notes: Demand grew almost 3% in 2025 and surpassed 100 Mt. Traditional industry and refining still dominate.

author: International Energy Agency
title: Global hydrogen review 2026: Production
notes: Reached almost 1 Mt in 2025. Expected to exceed 1% of global production in 2026. Concentrated in China, Europe and North America.

author: International Energy Agency
title: Global hydrogen review 2026: Production
notes: Doubled in 2025 to surpass 4 GW. More than 2.5 GW under construction for 2026 operation. Not all of this is alkaline nickel mesh.

author: International Energy Agency
title: Global hydrogen review 2026: Production
notes: Operating, under construction or FID. Up 3%. Could exceed 6 Mt if strong-potential projects reach FID in 2026 or 2027. WEO 2025 had 4.2 Mt for the same class.

author: International Energy Agency
title: Global hydrogen review 2026: Production
notes: Shrunk by 10 Mt. Not a bankable equipment forecast. New FIDs in 2025 were below 0.8 Mtpa.
